headline: A 2001 executive order launching a federal effort focused on preparing the American workforce for the 21st century.
what_it_does: This order, signed by President George W. Bush, set up a '21st Century Workforce Initiative.' The title suggests it directs federal attention to helping American workers adjust to a changing economy. No official summary was provided, so the specific actions, offices, or programs it created are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: The initiative is aimed at the US workforce, but the source material does not say exactly how workers are affected.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed June 20, 2001; the source does not give a separate effective date.
